product_graph_all_ADE_classification.scope: orientation-preserving product graph actions Gamma -> SO(3)xSO(3) with both projections injective; excludes factor-swap groups, which remain to be enumerated separately
product_graph_all_ADE_classification.endpoint_weight_test: For a stabilizer of order m, endpoint choices give local complex weights (1,a) and (1,-a). Requiring both to be ADE/SU(2) gives 1+a=0 and 1-a=0 mod m, hence m divides 2.
product_graph_all_ADE_classification.conclusion_in_scope: Only C2 and D2=V4 graph actions can have exclusively A1/ADE isolated singularities in this product-action class.

product_graph_all_ADE_classification.remaining_out_of_scope: isometries exchanging the two S2 factors or non-graph actions; these need an Agent3 finite-group enumeration if the product-quotient wall becomes central.

session_level_conclusions: If R_epsilon(p) zeta = 0 at every A1 replacement, the refined four-bubble approximate metrics have delta_+(g_t) <= C t^(1/2) -> 0, regardless of higher-order exact-Einstein obstructions.

For (S2 x S2)/Z2, r=0 and r=4 are harmless for Yau-26 because the underlying del Pezzo degree-4 diffeotype is known to admit positive Einstein metrics; r=1,2,3 are concrete mixed-chirality targets, not resolved by current Einstein-existence knowledge.
The balanced r=2 row is not forced; Yau-26 is orientation-free, so every mixed row whose smooth manifold lacks known Einstein metrics matters.
Within product graph actions, the only all-ADE cases are Z2 and V4; factor-swap actions and smooth-type/parity remain open finite checks.
